preconditions.description: The number of students n must be between 1 and 1000.
The number of buses k must be between 1 and 10^9.
The number of days d must be between 1 and 1000.

postconditions.expression: stdout == '-1' if n > k**d else True
postconditions.description: If the number of students exceeds the total unique bus arrangements, output -1.

postconditions.expression: all(len(line.split()) == n for line in stdout.splitlines())
postconditions.description: Each line of output must contain exactly n integers representing bus assignments.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(bus) <= k for line in stdout.splitlines() for bus in line.split())
postconditions.description: All bus numbers in the output must be between 1 and k.
